en: Black‑and‑white image of a rural village street centered on a two‑storey building with the sign "Restaurant… König Albert Eiche." The house is covered in vines and fronted by a fenced garden. Several adults and children stand in front, one person with a dog, and a child with a small cart. A horse‑drawn carriage travels up the unpaved road to the right, flanked by trees, hedges, and small houses with gabled roofs. The scene has an early‑20th‑century Central European village atmosphere.
